# devopser_variables (Data Source)

A workspace's variables (tfe_variables). Sensitive values are empty.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "devopser_variables" "network" {
  workspace_id = data.devopser_workspace.network.id
}

output "env_keys" {
  value = [for v in data.devopser_variables.network.env : v.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `workspace_id` (String) The workspace to read.

### Read-Only

- `env` (List of Object) Environment variables only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--env))
- `id` (String) The workspace id.
- `terraform` (List of Object) Input variables only. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--terraform))
- `variables` (List of Object) Every variable. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--variables))
